additional_candidates.title: Five active forecast migrations are absent from the frozen migration-authority contract
additional_candidates.recommendation: Reconcile the active migration filenames, hashes, ordering classes, and intended deployment gates into one authoritative manifest and make the test derive from that contract rather than two divergent lists.
additional_candidates.expected_benefit: Restores a passing fail-closed migration authority check and prevents five active schema changes from bypassing the repository's reviewed deployment inventory.

decisions.title: Browser roles can execute arbitrary SQL through a SECURITY DEFINER RPC
decisions.summary: The active migration chain grants anon/authenticated execution of a SECURITY DEFINER routine that runs caller-supplied SQL, and the later hardening migration changes search_path without revoking execution.
decisions.recommendation: Verify deployed catalog parity without invoking the RPC, then revoke browser-role execution and retire or strictly privilege the arbitrary-SQL maintenance boundary.
decisions.expected_benefit: Removes a direct arbitrary-database-operation path from public browser roles.

decisions.title: Browser roles can invoke a SECURITY DEFINER table-truncation RPC
decisions.summary: The active baseline grants anon/authenticated execution of a routine that truncates rolling-player metrics and support payloads; no later active migration revokes it.
decisions.recommendation: Verify deployed catalog parity without invoking the RPC, revoke browser-role execution, and retain destructive maintenance only behind an explicit privileged operator boundary.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents unauthenticated destruction of two shared metric tables.

decisions.title: Twenty operational API surfaces are addressable without request authentication
decisions.summary: All twenty Pages API routes are statically addressable and none applies the repository's admin/cron authorization middleware. Fifteen GET-capable routes can mutate application data, six can start external work, four are read/no-op handlers whose audit wrapper still writes an audit row, and one stale DDL route is incompatible with the latest active schema.
decisions.recommendation: Apply an explicit authenticated admin/cron contract per route, remove mutation-capable GET behavior unless a verified scheduler requires it, and add negative authorization tests before re-enabling any privileged path.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents unauthenticated service-role writes, destructive updates, external scraping, and expensive compute triggers.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Decide which four read/no-op surfaces should remain routable and which routes require scheduler-compatible GET semantics.

decisions.title: CI job-scopes the Supabase service-role key to unrelated install and upload steps
decisions.summary: The rankings workflow exposes the production-capable key to checkout, dependency install, browser install, deployed-URL runs, and failure upload even though only the local-server test step may require it.
decisions.recommendation: Scope the minimum credential to the exact local-server test step and keep dependency, deployed-URL, and artifact steps credential-free.
decisions.expected_benefit: Reduces credential exposure across transitive package and browser-install code without reducing test coverage.

decisions.title: Pregame analytics can display plausible fabricated fallback values
decisions.summary: The pregame game route always renders GamePreview after game details load; missing odds and team inputs become realistic-looking fixed values, and the SWR error is not surfaced as unavailable data.
decisions.recommendation: Replace production mock fallbacks with explicit unavailable or partial states and keep fixtures only in tests or clearly labeled demos.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents users from treating invented probabilities and rates as observed analytics.

decisions.title: Active forecast migrations and the authoritative migration manifest disagree
decisions.summary: The frozen active directory contains five forecast migrations missing from both exact lists parsed by the migration-authority test, causing two deterministic test failures.
decisions.recommendation: Reconcile filenames, hashes, ordering classes, and deployment gates into one authoritative contract, then make the test and final summary consume it consistently.
decisions.expected_benefit: Restores the fail-closed migration gate and prevents active schema changes from escaping reviewed deployment provenance.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Owner must assign each forecast migration to a reviewed deployment class; the audit cannot infer production application state.

decisions.title: The configured sKO rewrite points to a missing filesystem handler
decisions.summary: functions/vercel.json targets /api/sko/pipeline/index.py, which is absent from the frozen universe, while authenticated Flask implementations live in functions/api/index.py.
decisions.recommendation: Choose the intended deployed handler contract, align the rewrite and entrypoint, and verify route resolution without invoking pipeline work.
decisions.expected_benefit: Restores a deterministic authenticated pipeline endpoint instead of a deployment-time missing target.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Choose whether the Flask aggregate or a dedicated Vercel function owns /sko/pipeline.

decisions.title: A stale unauthenticated materialization endpoint is incompatible with canonical schema authority
decisions.summary: The endpoint attempts non-atomic fixed-subset DDL and misreports its head-only count, but the latest active migration moves the materialization internal and exposes the public name as an ordinary view. Under that canonical shape the first DROP should fail before replacement; destructive replacement remains credible only under deployment drift.
decisions.recommendation: Keep the route disabled from operational use, verify deployed migration parity without invoking it, and retire it or replace it with the authoritative internal materialization workflow; if retained, also fix count handling and transactional behavior.
decisions.expected_benefit: Removes a privileged stale route and avoids either fail-closed operational breakage or destructive fixed-subset replacement under a drifted schema.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Decide whether the endpoint has any valid maintenance purpose after the internal_stats migration.

decisions.title: Natural Stat Trick team-table handlers expose inconsistent and success-shaped error contracts
decisions.summary: The aggregate Flask handler jsonify-wraps an already serialized string, while the standalone handler decodes it; upstream and parser failures are embedded in HTTP 200 payloads.
decisions.recommendation: Return structured data exactly once from both surfaces, emit non-2xx statuses for dependency/parser failures, and lock the shared contract with tests before changing callers.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes caller behavior deterministic and prevents upstream failure payloads from being treated as successful data.
decisions.confidence: High for status behavior; Medium for aggregate response consumer impact

decisions.title: Tracked next-env bootstrap is stale and is deterministically rewritten by normal Next dev
decisions.summary: The frozen file references an absent isolated-build route declaration. Normal tsc still passed, so no clean-checkout type failure was proven; however the disposable Next dev command rewrote the tracked file, creating concrete worktree churn.
decisions.recommendation: Establish the intended generated next-env authority for default versus isolated builds and verify a clean disposable typecheck/dev cycle without tracked-file churn.
decisions.expected_benefit: Removes recurring generated-file drift while preserving the successful typecheck contract.
decisions.confidence: High runtime for rewrite; no demonstrated typecheck failure

decisions.title: No automatic PR or push workflow exercises existing validation commands
decisions.summary: The sole workflow is manual-only and rankings-specific; the frozen migration-authority failure demonstrates a concrete regression that current CI would not catch.
decisions.recommendation: Add bounded PR/push validation using the existing npm-authoritative type, lint, and test commands while keeping secret-bearing browser work separately gated.
decisions.expected_benefit: Catches repository-contract regressions such as the current migration manifest mismatch before merge.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Choose required versus advisory checks and resource budget; do not automatically include live-data E2E.

decisions.title: The canonical lint script omits active first-party source and test trees
decisions.summary: The ESLint config supports broad JS/TS matching, but the package command names only pages, components, lib, and hooks, excluding active contexts, utils, test, E2E, and root TypeScript trees.
decisions.recommendation: Define the intended lint universe explicitly and include active omitted trees with deliberate exclusions for generated/evidence files.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes the configured lint contract cover the code and tests developers actually maintain.

decisions.title: Root setup guidance contradicts the npm and Node authority documented elsewhere
decisions.summary: The root README uses npm install, omits Node 22.11.0, and maps only web/CMS despite current functions, webhooks, and database boundaries.
decisions.recommendation: Make the root README a concise repository entrypoint that defers package setup to current authoritative package docs and lists every deployable/data boundary.
decisions.expected_benefit: Reduces incorrect setup and incomplete repository orientation.

decisions.title: Retained documentation contains 2,044 developer-local absolute paths across 212 files
decisions.summary: Machine-local links make current documents unusable in other clones and code hosts; historical archived evidence should not be rewritten when that would reduce fidelity.
decisions.recommendation: Convert links only in Keep or Needs owner decision documents to repository-relative paths and preserve historical archive prose with a relocation index where needed.
decisions.expected_benefit: Restores portable navigation without falsifying archived evidence.

decisions.title: Documentation contains 782 target-absent repository paths across 166 files
decisions.summary: The absent targets mix stale locations, archived artifacts, intentionally retired source, placeholders, and ignored/generated evidence; target absence alone is not deletion evidence.
decisions.recommendation: Repair references only in Keep or Needs owner decision documents; use archive banners or relocation indexes for historical evidence rather than rewriting it indiscriminately.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes active documentation navigable while preserving historical context and avoiding false cleanup conclusions.

decisions.title: Rolling-player source records disagree about pass-two completion
decisions.summary: One source retains fourteen open and one planned status while its matched task list is fully checked and the master super-goal says complete.
decisions.recommendation: Map each open item to a completion receipt, intentional deferral, or active owner before archiving or retaining the backlog.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents operational work from being silently lost behind a contradictory completed status.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Owner must decide which open statuses remain active after receipt reconciliation.

decisions.title: Checked-in editor MCP configuration auto-executes an unpinned network package
decisions.summary: The VS Code MCP configuration uses npx -y for an unversioned package, allowing editor activation to fetch and execute changing code without an install prompt.
decisions.recommendation: Make the integration explicit opt-in and pin a reviewed version or locked local tool path, documenting the network boundary.
decisions.expected_benefit: Reduces unreviewed supply-chain execution from repository-local editor configuration.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Confirm whether repository-wide editor configuration is intended for all contributors.

decisions.title: VS Code debug launch commands conflict with npm package-manager authority
decisions.summary: Both launch entries run yarn dev while the package manifest, lockfile, and repository documentation establish npm as the sole authority.
decisions.recommendation: Align launch commands with npm run dev and document the stable watcher variant where applicable.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents editor-launched development from using an unsupported package-manager path.

decisions.title: Desktop navigation submenus depend on pointer hover
decisions.summary: Category triggers are not focusable buttons and CSS opens submenus through hover, leaving keyboard users without an equivalent disclosure contract.
decisions.recommendation: Use focusable disclosure triggers with aria-expanded/controls and support keyboard/focus as well as pointer interaction.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes primary site navigation usable without a pointer.
decisions.confidence: High static; runtime keyboard verification required

decisions.title: Mobile and desktop navigation expose different primary destination sets
decisions.summary: Eight desktop destinations are absent from the mobile menu. This is a verified cross-viewport contract difference, but omission alone does not prove that every destination belongs in mobile primary navigation.
decisions.recommendation: Define the intended primary-navigation contract, then expose only the destinations confirmed as primary through an appropriate mobile grouping.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes navigation differences intentional and prevents mobile users from losing required primary routes.
decisions.confidence: High static difference; product intent unknown
decisions.product_decision_gate: Product owner must classify the eight destinations as primary, secondary, or intentionally desktop-only before implementation.

decisions.title: Shared custom click targets lack native keyboard semantics
decisions.summary: A quantified JSX scan found thirty candidates across twenty files; the shared Options/Select primitives and ranking/team table instances provide concrete nonsemantic click targets, but each candidate still requires semantic adjudication.
decisions.recommendation: Prioritize shared primitives and primary tables, use native controls where semantics match, and runtime-verify focus, activation, and accessible names per instance.
decisions.expected_benefit: Restores keyboard and assistive-technology access without blanket-converting semantically neutral containers.

decisions.title: Legacy PP TOI chart lacks a small-screen and non-pointer access path
decisions.summary: The chart uses hover-driven SVG interaction and its owned stylesheet has no media query. Browser confirmation was unavailable, so computed clipping remains unverified, but the absent keyboard/table alternative is deterministic.
decisions.recommendation: Provide an owned small-screen layout and accessible table or keyboard interaction, then verify desktop/tablet/mobile behavior with representative data.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes power-play TOI data usable on small screens and without hover.

decisions.title: Two independently owned game-detail stylesheets are byte-identical
decisions.summary: The 451-line GamePreview module and stats-game module share the same SHA-256 while both have active consumers.
decisions.recommendation: Choose one owner or a narrowly shared partial, migrate one consumer, verify both routes at three viewports, and retire the duplicate only after zero-consumer proof.
decisions.expected_benefit: Removes 451 duplicated style lines and prevents divergent fixes across two game-detail surfaces.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Choose component ownership before moving or deleting either active stylesheet.

decisions.title: TeamLandingPage CSS duplicates the imported SCSS after whitespace normalization
decisions.summary: Both 809-line files normalize to the same content and _app imports only the SCSS path, but dynamic/manual/build consumers cannot be ruled out solely from static references.
decisions.recommendation: Confirm SCSS authority through build input, history, and owner checks; then remove the CSS copy only after zero-consumer proof.
decisions.expected_benefit: Avoids maintaining 809 duplicated lines and an ambiguous global style authority.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Owner must confirm the CSS file has no external/manual generation contract.

decisions.title: Breakpoint literals duplicate an established Sass token vocabulary
decisions.summary: The 166 stylesheets contain 551 media queries, including 46 literal 480px and 33 literal 768px conditions alongside 52 mobile-token and 50 tablet-token uses.
decisions.recommendation: Group conditions by semantic boundary, migrate only equivalent literals one ownership group at a time, and verify all three viewports before retiring aliases.
decisions.expected_benefit: Reduces breakpoint drift without flattening intentionally distinct layout thresholds.

decisions.title: Configured staging Sanity workspace lacks a matching deployment route
decisions.summary: Sanity declares /staging-studio, while CMS and web deployment configs provide a contract only for /studio.
decisions.recommendation: If staging is intentionally addressable, add and verify a matching deployment route; otherwise document or remove the non-deployed workspace contract in a later implementation task.
decisions.expected_benefit: Aligns the intentional staging editor surface with its actual deployment boundary.
decisions.product_decision_gate: Confirm whether /staging-studio is intended to be deployed.

decisions.title: CMS retains parallel Sanity v3 and legacy v2-era configuration artifacts
decisions.summary: The active package/config is v3-shaped while sanity.json and config metadata retain v2-era structure; current command/build ownership and unique migration knowledge remain unresolved.
decisions.recommendation: Trace CMS command/build inputs and pinned history, then classify each legacy artifact as Keep, Archive, Merge, or a later delete candidate; do not remove it from static age or unlinking alone.
decisions.expected_benefit: Clarifies CMS authority without discarding migration knowledge or compatibility state.
decisions.product_decision_gate: CMS owner must confirm whether v2-era config retains a migration or deployment purpose.

decisions.title: Executable SQL validation scripts hard-code one workstation checkout
decisions.summary: Both scripts discover environment files only beneath one absolute /Users checkout, preventing equivalent clones from using the same documented path.
decisions.recommendation: Use repository-relative explicit configuration or require environment injection; keep secret values outside source and logs.
decisions.expected_benefit: Makes the validation tools portable while preserving secret-handling boundaries.

decisions.title: A self-executing legacy WGO updater reads a misspelled service-role variable
decisions.summary: The module uses NNEXT_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, immediately executes at import, and has no other frozen consumer of that variable spelling; current ownership is unresolved.
decisions.recommendation: First decide whether the updater is active. If retained, use explicit validated configuration and a guarded entrypoint; if superseded, route it through cleanup evidence rather than silently fixing it.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents accidental import-time execution and a guaranteed credential mismatch on the legacy path.
decisions.confidence: High source behavior; current ownership unknown
decisions.product_decision_gate: Owner must classify the updater as active or superseded before code change or removal.

decisions.title: Two tracked sKO output roots contain same-named divergent artifacts
decisions.summary: The timings pair is byte-identical, while three same-named Parquet pairs have different hashes; no source establishes the nested root's producer or authority.
decisions.recommendation: Identify producing commands, run provenance, and downstream consumers before choosing an authority or considering merge/archive/deletion.
decisions.expected_benefit: Prevents model consumers from silently selecting divergent tracked outputs and avoids deleting the only authoritative run.
decisions.confidence: High duplication/divergence; Low desired cleanup action
decisions.product_decision_gate: Model owner must identify the authoritative run/output root.

no_justified_change_records.scope: repository-wide caching, memoization, query batching, code splitting, and data-retention optimization
no_justified_change_records.conclusion: No separate broad optimization is justified. The audit found security-triggered expensive work and endpoint-contract defects, but did not obtain representative production timing, query-plan, payload-volume, or cache-hit measurements sufficient for generic performance advice.
no_justified_change_records.confidence: High in the decision not to speculate

no_justified_change_records.scope: repository-wide logging, tracing, metrics, and alerting additions
no_justified_change_records.conclusion: No blanket observability program is justified from frozen source alone. Existing cron audit records and bounded diagnostics were inventoried; specific auth and response-contract findings already carry the narrow validation they need.
no_justified_change_records.confidence: High in the decision not to generalize

no_justified_change_records.scope: page-wide visual redesign or stylistic modernization
no_justified_change_records.conclusion: No broad redesign is justified. Of 216 viewport records, 207 have no justified route-specific visual change; the remaining nine point only to two concrete accessibility/responsive findings, while the shared navigation findings are handled separately.
no_justified_change_records.confidence: Medium because 215 viewport records use explicit static fallbacks

no_justified_change_records.scope: dependency upgrades, framework migration, and technique modernization
no_justified_change_records.conclusion: No dependency upgrade or framework migration is justified by version age alone. The audit records current versions and concrete configuration defects but did not identify an upgrade-specific security advisory or blocked requirement.

No recommendation to add tests everywhere is justified. The 3,732 passing test observations and two focused migration failures support only targeted authorization, endpoint-contract, responsive-interaction, and migration-authority regression tests attached to accepted findings.

supplemental_cleanup_records.confidence: high for duplication; owner choice pending
supplemental_cleanup_records.rationale: Both active 451-line stylesheets are byte-identical. Consolidation is justified, but the owning path must be chosen and both consumers verified before either file is retired.
The CSS normalizes to the imported SCSS content, but manual, generated, or external consumer purpose has not been ruled out.
Legacy v2-era artifacts overlap active v3 configuration, but build/migration ownership and unique retained knowledge are unresolved.

supplemental_cleanup_records.confidence: high for divergence; low for cleanup action
supplemental_cleanup_records.rationale: Same-named tracked sKO artifacts diverge across two roots and producer/consumer authority is unproven.
The updater self-executes with a misspelled credential name, but frozen evidence does not prove whether it is active or superseded.
